name: ContextQARunTestPlan
description: Run a ContextQA test plan, publish its results, and fail unless it passes.
author: ContextQA

inputs.name: planId
inputs.label: Test plan ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: The number in the test plan's URL.

inputs.name: token
inputs.label: API token
inputs.helpMarkDown: A secret pipeline variable holding a ContextQA API token. Needs TEST_PLAN_EXECUTE and TEST_PLAN_RESULTS_READ, plus TEST_PLAN_BUILD_UPLOAD to upload builds and TEST_CASE_RESULTS_READ for per-test results.

inputs.name: androidBuild
inputs.label: Android build
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to an .apk/.aab to upload, or an https URL to pass through.

inputs.name: iosBuild
inputs.label: iOS build
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to an .ipa to upload, or an https URL to pass through.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.label: Environment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run against this environment instead of the plan's default.

inputs.name: apiUrl
inputs.label: API URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Change it for a dedicated or on-premises tenant.

inputs.name: publishTestResults
inputs.label: Publish results to the Tests tab

inputs.name: junitPath
inputs.label: JUnit file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where to write the JUnit XML. Defaults to the agent's temp directory.

outputVariables.name: reportUrl
outputVariables.description: Link to the run report in ContextQA.

outputVariables.name: result
outputVariables.description: Run verdict, e.g. SUCCESS or FAILURE.
